title: net/http, no framework
notes: The sample application on Go's standard library alone: net/http, html/template and encoding/json. The cost of using no framework.
details: The sample application on Go's standard library alone: net/http's ServeMux with method and wildcard patterns, html/template for the pages (which does the escaping) and encoding/json for the API: the cost of using no framework. One process on the default Go scheduler (GOMAXPROCS is every core), built with go build and no flags beyond -mod=readonly. Go has no build-time prerendering, so /about is a template with no data, rendered on each request like the item page; the templates are parsed once when the server starts. No request logging.
